text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired (PD: P0) for service=redwood-gpu-pool-A - symptom=CUDA_ALLOC_FAILED / GPU memory pressure

pagerduty: PD alert -> oncall sam acknowledged the page at 1779990005

sam: seeing lots of CUDA_ALLOC_FAILED in the logs across multiple nodes in pool-A. OOM spike started ~5m ago.

nerc: ok can you paste the recent driver logs? stack traces?

sam: pasting excerpt from one node:

```
2026-02-25T14:26:37Z ERROR runtime: cudaAlloc returned CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED
2026-02-25T14:26:37Z WARN kvcache: eviction waterfall started, evicting 42 entries
2026-02-25T14:26:38Z ERROR model-server: out of memory allocating kv cache 512MB
2026-02-25T14:26:39Z WARN schedule: preemption of low-priority work
```

sam: pattern looks like kvcache thrash followed by alloc failures. Not obviously driver reset.

lee: any recent deploy to the pool? autoscaler change?

sam: no deploys in last hour. Autoscaler did a small upscale earlier but that should reduce pressure.

natalie: Customer support flagged increased error rate for embeddings and chat in prod region eu-west-1 ~ impact: ~8% of requests failing with 503s. Customers: two medium-sized tenants hitting long context generation.

infra-oncall: I can ssh into gpu-node-17 and check memory maps. Pulling nv_top now.

pagerduty: escalation: if unacked for >5m escalate to infra-oncall (escalation policy triggered)

sam: ack, starting live mitigation plan: 1) reduce concurrency target for pool-A to 60% 2) rotate problematic nodes 3) route requests larger than 32k tokens to quantized-variant fallback 4) enable aggressive kvcache pruning on pool-A runtime.

nerc: commands to run?

sam: run:
```
./infractl pool update --name pool-A --concurrency-target 0.6
./infractl node drain gpu-node-17 --reason "OOM spike investigation"
```

sam: also patch runtime config on pool-A:
```
kvcache.prune_threshold=0.4
kvcache.max_entries_per_model=10000
```

lee: I pushed the concurrency change, seeing immediate drop in outstanding in-flight tokens. Errors per second reduced from 18/s -> 6/s in the metric dashboard.

natalie: support: notifying impacted customers with a brief note: "We're investigating elevated GPU memory errors affecting a subset of requests; a mitigation is in progress."

infra-oncall: on gpu-node-17 nv_top shows sustained 99% memory usage with multiple python processes holding large KV segments. I requested a soft-restart of model-server on that node.

sam: soft-restart acked. Will monitor. If node doesn't recover, we evacuate and reprovision.

pagerduty: sam escalated to natalie after 12m - handoff for customer comms and post-incident followup

natalie: I will coordinate customer notifications and track SLO impact. Current estimate: 00:12 outage window for affected requests.

sam: restart succeeded on node-17, memory reclaimed, alloc errors dropped to baseline on that node. However cluster-wide the kvcache eviction rate remains high. Suspect KV leak for certain model variant (llama-large-ctx-64k-quant).

lee: trace shows many long-running KV slots not being freed after requests with streaming; looks like incomplete flush on streaming failures. I've opened a small fix in runtime to force KV flush on connection close: PR #4227.

eric: can we mitigate without deploy? maybe ttl-based aggressive pruning is enough for now.

sam: enabled prune_threshold and reduced max_entries. Metrics show kvcache size dropping steadily.

pagerduty: incident-bot: page acknowledged, update frequency every 5m until resolved.

natalie: Customer impact update: 2 customers had degraded throughput, some 503s for long-context requests. No data exfiltration. Recording affected tenant IDs for follow-up.

sam: plan for next 2 hours: 1) keep pool-A concurrency limited 2) monitor kvcache evictions and OOMs 3) ship runtime PR to force KV flush (low-risk) 4) run targeted canary deploy to pool-A in 30m.

lee: adding temporary routing rule: requests with context > 48k tokens get routed to quantized-cpu-fallback to avoid large kv usage on GPU for now. Implemented in routing layer.

sam: metrics at +25m: errors down to baseline, evictions reduced by 70%. I'll leave concurrency capped until runtime PR lands.

natalie: closing customer notifications loop: two tenants acknowledged and appreciate the quick mitigation. Marking severity as P1 -> P2 after stabilization.

infra-oncall: leaving node-17 out of rotation for 1 hour; monitoring for recurrence.

sam: logging postmortem action items: - merge PR #4227 (force kv flush) - add unit test for streaming connection close path - add eviction alert with early leading indicator (kv_growth_rate) - consider default prune config tighter for long-context models - run chaos test for heavy kv churn.

natalie: I'll create the incident ticket and attach timeline. Moving thread to resolved-watch for 1h. :white_check_mark:
